summary: PASS at HEAD 82114591, with a result close to the bar. The paint-splash is rated 7.0 out of 10 (bar 7.0, earlier 6.5). The ten criteria give a mean of 6.9, and the visible ring on the face caps the rating at 7.0. B1 is closed, but not fully. The foot tab is gone, the value contrast is real, and the outline is now an irregular blob. A ring seam still shows on the face, because the rim stands 5 to 8 mm higher than the centre. The front cutouts read as glossy paint blobs in red, blue, and yellow. The three-quarter cutouts read as a wax seal. The mechanical checks pass and the scope is clean. The brief and the code header make false statements about the geometry. The stage still cannot place a blue or yellow splash (N3 of the earlier result, now N6). The diff since 03d1114d changes only assets/paint-splash.ts among the sources. The earlier results for the sun, cloud, flower, grape-bunch, and duck therefore still hold.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Medium] paint-splash ring seam (assets/paint-splash.ts:78-94, out/paint-splash/render.png): B1 named ring seams on the face, and the r2 brief says they are gone. A ring remains. render.png shows a circle about 100 mm from the centre, arcs at the lobes, and soft bubble-like highlights on the lobes. The ring shows faintly in the front cutouts (clearest on blue) and strongly in the three-quarter cutouts, where a plate inside a raised rim reads as a wax seal. Cause, measured on the built GLB: the face stands 16.5 to 17.9 mm high for r 20 to 60 mm, and 21.5 to 24.8 mm high for r 60 to 130 mm. The rim zone stands 5 to 8 mm above the dome. The lobes and drops have the same z radius as the dome, and 13 sequential smoothUnion calls with k 0.025 stack the bulge. Suggested change: lower the z radius of the lobes and drops (about 0.008 to 0.010 m), or clip the body with one dome, so the face falls from the centre to the rim. Check the z profile and render.png, then re-cut the cutouts and the card. This change is optional for this gate. The owner of the look check decides. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green)

N2 [Low] false statements in the r2 brief and the code header (assets/paint-splash.ts:7 and 17-20; briefs/paint-splash.md r2 changes 2 and 3, and Known differences): the text says the paint is 0.025 m thick at the rim and 0.033 m at the centre, and that the face carries no ring seam. The built GLB shows a centre 0.033 to 0.036 m thick and a rim zone up to 0.050 m thick (bounds z -0.025 to 0.025). It also shows a visible ring (N1). The brief says the fillet adds about 7 mm and gives a bounding box of 0.05 m. The box is true, but the 0.025 m rim is not. Suggested change: fix the geometry (N1) and keep the text, or correct the text to the measured values. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green)

N3 [Low] droplets read as rim bumps (the maker's first question): confirmed. The polar silhouette of the front cutout measures 155 mm at 92 deg, 157 mm at 188 deg, and 153 mm at 324 deg, against 141 to 146 mm on each side. Each drop stands 10 to 15 mm proud of its lobes, with no neck and no gap. The PM brief asked for thin necks, but the r2 order set one fillet, so the maker followed the order. The book row asks only for big round splashes, so the book is met. A smaller k on the necks alone would bring the drops back. Suggested change: the orchestrator decides whether the drops must read as drops. | owner: orchestrator (design decision)

N4 [Nit] highlights and hatching: the studio light puts 5 or 6 soft white blotches on the lobes, and they read as bubbles. At 4x zoom the blue front cutout shows streaky hatching at the edge of a highlight, near the ring at the upper right. The mesh has 1242 vertices and 1968 triangles, and the texture is 512 px. Neither effect shows at 1x or at the 128 px scale. Suggested change: none needed now. A dome clip (N1) may smooth the normals.

N5 [Info] the foot (the maker's second question): the foot is buried and shows no tab. In the GLB the |z| at the bottom centre is 0.0128 to 0.0135 m, with no step at |x| 0.03 m. The flat bottom spans x -0.0727 to 0.0885 m, wider than the 0.06 m foot. The only trace is a 1 mm heel (bottomY -0.001). The foot looks dark because the dark band covers the flat bottom, and that gives a contact shade. This is not a defect. The foot box adds nothing and could go.

N6 [Medium] stage wiring (outside this step; it carries N3 of the earlier result): out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props/manifest.json lists only paint-splash/front and paint-splash/three-quarter (red). The blue and yellow cutouts sit in presets/blue and presets/yellow, and nothing reads them. A stage prop has no preset field. The week 3 line 'It is red! It is blue! It is yellow, too!' therefore still shows three red splashes. The plan words 'preset cutouts done' are true for the files, but not for the scene. Suggested change: the orchestrator opens a task for a preset field on a stage prop, or for manifest entries. | owner: orchestrator

N7 [Nit] commit scope: e5e2350c adds acceptance-week3-03d1114.json and .log (the earlier gate result). The commit title does not name them. The maker log lists them as 'added unchanged', and git shows no change to them in the working tree. This is the same pattern as N8 of the earlier result.

N8 [Info] open items outside this step: the earlier findings N1 (1 px alpha seam in sun and flower cutouts), N2 (flower base), N4 to N11 stay open for their owners. This step changes none of them, and this run did not re-judge them.

B1 fault 1, foot tab: FIXED. In the built GLB the |z| of the vertices in the bottom 30 mm is 0.0128 to 0.0135 m for x -0.03 to 0.0 m, and it rises smoothly into the lobes on both sides. No step shows at |x| 0.03 m. The 4x crop of the bottom edge shows a flat dark edge and no rectangle. The only trace is a 1 mm heel (bottomY -0.001, the foot fillet).

B1 fault 2, ring seams on the face: NOT FIXED (the form changed). The lobe rings are softer. One large ring at r about 100 mm, arcs at the lobes, and soft bubble-like blotches remain. They show in render.png (front, three-quarter, back), in the blue front cutout as a pale diagonal line, and in all three three-quarter cutouts. GLB z by radius: dome 16.5 to 17.9 mm for r 20 to 60 mm; rim zone 21.5 to 24.8 mm for r 60 to 130 mm. The rim bead is 5 to 8 mm above the dome. See N1.

B1 fault 3, flat value: FIXED. The red front cutout has 58194 opaque pixels. Luma (0 to 255): p10 82.6, p50 108.6, p90 148.0, mean 111.5, sd 26.6. The radial mean luma is 123 to 126 for r 0 to 24 mm, 111 for r 48 to 68 mm, 115 to 118 for r 76 to 100 mm, and 103 falling to 81 for r 124 to 148 mm. The rim band is 25 to 30 percent darker than the inside. The mean colour is #e85046 (opaque) and #e75046 (alpha weighted); the old build read #f3635c.

B1 fault 4, scalloped badge: PARTLY FIXED. The silhouette radius runs from 102 mm (flat bottom) to 157 mm. The valleys between lobes are 12 to 17 mm deep and the lobes differ in size, so the outline is an irregular blob and not a regular scallop. In the front cutouts the shape reads as a glossy paint blob. The plate inside a raised rim still reads as a wax seal in the three-quarter view and in the studio render.

Rating paint-splash 7.0 (pass, earlier 6.5): brief match 4, silhouette 3.5, proportion and appeal 3, shape language 3, value and colour 3.5, materials 3.5, detail hierarchy 3, technical quality 3.5, game readiness 4, readability at 128 px 3.5. The sum is 34.5, the mean is 3.45 of 5, and that gives 6.9 of 10. The ring seam (N1) is a visible defect, so it caps the rating at 7.0, as in the earlier run. The result is close to the bar: a drop of 0.5 in two criteria gives 6.5.

The maker's three questions. (1) The drops read as rim bumps: confirmed (N3). (2) The foot is dark: confirmed, and harmless (N5). (3) The centre stays mid-value: confirmed. The centre luma is 123 to 126 (it carries the studio highlight), and the value contrast comes from the dark rim. I judge this acceptable. A darker centre is not needed.

Colour and presets: the three preset renders differ in colour (render.png red, render.blue.png blue, render.yellow.png yellow). The mean colours of the front cutouts are red #e85046, blue #4980c0, and yellow #f0c448. The brief says #e74f45, #487fbf, and #f0c447. All three lie within 1 level per channel, so the brief is true. The book row is quoted from the brief and the earlier result: 'three big round splashes in a row: red, blue, yellow'. I did not re-read the monorepo inventory in this run.
